claims.title: Finite-field Frobenius localizer and vanishing on every other plane
claims.statement: The determinant product localizer vanishes coefficientwise in every other rational-plane chart. The proof factors each Frobenius minor as det(T_j)det(H_I)^(p^z_j), telescopes the exponent to p^z0(q0-1), and uses an exchanged minor from Cramer; no det(T_j) inversion is needed.

claims.statement: Every own-chart Rloc-R0 term has form w^e X^nu product Delta_j^(alpha_j-b_j) H with e>=1, |nu|<=e, b_j<=e, H integral tangential. Product errors add these budgets. This is stronger than reduction modulo w.

claims.statement: Bordered determinants at even positions and primal-dual pairings at odd positions produce valid order-one keys; adjugate identities express w X_(s,b) D_s in their tangential span. The label digit bound m_(s,b)<=Q leaves at most kQ normal factors per position, proving RestMon without division by D_s.

claims.title: Finite cleaning with exact spare-exponent invariants
claims.statement: For a key of order d<=2Q, a normal-degree-v error has coefficient w^x with x=max(d+1,v); E=x-d>=1 and v<=(2Q+1)E. Combining SY3/SY4 raises level by E while decreasing mu by (2Q+1)E and lambda by E. Initial ((2Q+3)c,c), level>=o, suffices to correct finitely to o+c while retaining off-plane vanishing. Projection preserves multidegree.
